claim_boundary: One task family, one generation, five children per arm, eight held-out samples per child. Far short of POC_PLAN's three generations and five independent lineages with sealed transfer.
method: Every child is scored on held-out instances with no selection step, so improvers are compared in expectation rather than by their best single child.
question: Judged by the MEAN held-out quality of the children it produces, is the descendant a better improver than its ancestor?
